sections.label: MOE developing 21CC in students
sections.summary: MOE strives to develop 21CC in every student so they can thrive in a fast-changing, inter-connected world.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: MOE strives to develop 21CC in every student to enable them to thrive in a fast-changing and increasingly inter-connected world.

sections.label: Soft skills at IHLs
sections.summary: IHL students continue developing soft skills through course programmes and applied learning like attachments, internships and community service.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: When students progress to the Institutes of Higher Learning or IHLs, they continue to develop soft skills through their course programmes and applied learning opportunities such as industry attachments, internships and community service programmes.

sections.label: Gauging impact on student outcomes
sections.summary: Schools and institutions gauge impact on student outcomes through regular programme reviews and student feedback.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Schools and institutions gauge the impact on student outcomes through regular programme reviews as well as student feedback.

sections.label: Face-to-face interactions in schools
sections.summary: Schools and IHLs seek sufficient face-to-face interaction for students, with resumed activities and classes capped at 50 persons.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Even with safe management measures in place, our schools and IHLs seek to ensure that students spend sufficient time in face-to-face interactions, be it in classrooms, CCAs or other activities, so that they can benefit from a more holistic education experience.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: For example, schools will be allowed to further resume activities that are held outside of school and those that involve fixed inter-mingling of students across schools, during their post-exam period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Classes and consultations, previously conducted online, are allowed to resume, with no more than 50 persons per class.

sections.label: Teachers identifying weaker students
sections.summary: Teachers continue to identify weaker students who may need more help and pay more attention to them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The teachers in the classrooms continue to identify students who are weaker and who may need more help, and will pay more attention to them.

sections.label: Uplifting students lacking opportunities
sections.summary: Schools pay attention to students from certain backgrounds who may lack exposure and opportunities, to uplift them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: On the second point, we are also mindful that there will be students from certain backgrounds who may lack the exposure and the opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: That is why schools also pay a lot of attention to this segment of students to try and uplift them and provide them with more opportunities.
